Order 
This is the third application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.53/2022 dated 17.06.2022, registered at Police Station Pipat, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 376, 450 of IPC.

Applicant's first and second bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 13.12.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.52985/2022 and 15.02.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.4054/2023.
